tickets.subject: CSV export fails on large project
tickets.body: Export of a project with about 55k tasks returns EXPORT_500.
tickets.resolution_summary: Known issue ENG-101 on 2.4. Customer used Prepare in background; export succeeded. Ticket linked to ENG-101.

tickets.subject: XLSX export missing custom fields
tickets.body: Custom fields are not in the XLSX file.
tickets.resolution_summary: On 2.3 this was ENG-102, fixed in 2.4. Customer upgraded and confirmed columns present.

tickets.subject: Export hits row limit
tickets.body: Export stops with EXPORT_LIMIT.
tickets.resolution_summary: Explained the plan row limit and recommended filtering or background export.

tickets.subject: SAML login rejected
tickets.body: Users see SAML_CLOCK_SKEW when signing in.
tickets.resolution_summary: Identity provider clock was 4 minutes fast. Customer fixed NTP; logins succeeded.

tickets.subject: Webhook retries stop early
tickets.body: Deliveries stop retrying after 3 attempts.
tickets.resolution_summary: Matches ENG-104 on 2.5. Linked ticket; advised replaying from the delivery log.

tickets.subject: How to verify webhook signatures
tickets.body: What is the signature algorithm?
tickets.resolution_summary: Shared the webhooks setup article: HMAC-SHA256 over raw body with endpoint secret.

tickets.subject: Digest email late
tickets.body: Digest arrived hours late.
tickets.resolution_summary: Linked to the notifications incident and ENG-105; shared the public status summary.

tickets.subject: 429 without Retry-After
tickets.body: Rate limited responses lack headers.
tickets.resolution_summary: Matches ENG-106. Advised exponential backoff starting at 1 second until fixed.

tickets.subject: API rate limit question
tickets.body: What is the API limit per minute?
tickets.resolution_summary: 600 requests per minute per token; shared the rate limits article.

tickets.subject: Proration credit shown twice
tickets.body: Invoice preview shows the same credit twice.
tickets.resolution_summary: Display issue ENG-107, fixed in 2.4.2; final invoices were correct.

tickets.subject: Archived project appears in search
tickets.body: Archived projects show up in global search.
tickets.resolution_summary: Matches ENG-108 on 2.5; linked.
